costs.scope: OpenRouter spend recorded in the published receipts. SubQ Snap (own preview API) and agent-led use outside the studies are not counted.
costs.per_board: Cost of the graded attempts only: the scored receipts of the boards whose cost is known, divided by their number. Re-runs, version probes and order controls, text-only diagnostics and board-less requests count toward the total, not the per-board figure.

basis.derived: batch item: tokens x batch price, cached input at a tenth of the input price (reproduces the billed batch total)
basis.unbilled: HTTP 4xx rejection before any generation; billed $0
basis.unknown: no generation ID or usage (client timeout or upstream 5xx); not counted
